inbox_intro: Everything is already stored unchanged. Here you decide what it is and how long it stays.
inbox_empty_text: Upload a document or connect a source.
archive_intro: All documents, searchable. Required and voluntary ones are locked, free ones can be deleted any time.
archive_search: Full text in documents, mails and attachments, or ASN
archive_empty_text: What you upload or a source delivers shows up here.
archive_no_match_text: Try a different search or remove the filters.
retention_intro: How long each kind of document stays locked.
retention_start: The period starts at the end of the calendar year in which the document was created, received or sent (§ 147 (4) AO).
retention_hold: The period does not end while the records matter for a tax whose assessment period is still open (§ 147 (3) sentence 5 AO). Documents are therefore only deleted after you confirm.
audit_intro: Access for tax auditors, data export by the official description standard, audit report and procedure documentation.
sources_intro: Where documents come from, which rules help with classification and which programs may use Belegt.
scan_intro: Put a separator sheet between the documents of a stack and scan everything into one PDF. From the inbox folder (or when uploading through the API with trennen=1) Belegt splits the stack at each separator sheet; every part becomes its own document, the separator sheet itself does not.
procedure_intro: Belegt describes how it captures, retains, protects and deletes records. Enter below what only you can know.
login_setup_intro: The first account is the owner. Further access comes later by invitation.
upload_duplicate: “{name}” is already in the archive, nothing new was added:
upload_duplicate_hidden: “{name}” is already in the archive, nothing new was added.
doc_no_preview: There is no preview for this type.
classify_none: Not classified yet. Only the classification sets the retention period.
classify_until_free: none, can be deleted any time
classify_hint: A change is added as a new version; the old one stays in the history.
overview_deletable_hint: Period ended or free, not on hold
holds_intro: Documents created within the period are kept even after their period ends, for example for a tax audit.
login_setup_code_hint: Shown in the server log on first start.
invite_intro: You were invited as {rolle}. Create your account.
invite_invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.
access_intro: Who can use Belegt. Tax advisors and auditors can only read, employees see only their scope.
access_link: Invitation link, valid for 72 hours and once:
delete_requested: Requested by {wer} on {wann}. A second person confirms.
delete_done: Deleted on {wann}, requested by {antrag}, confirmed by {bestaetigt}. The file is removed; hash, details and history remain as proof.
delete_hint: The retention period has ended. Check with your tax advisor first whether an assessment period is still open (§ 147 (3) sentence 5 AO).
delete_hint_before: It was filed differently before: a second person confirms the deletion.
delete_hint_free: Stored freely: you can delete it right away.
delete_now_follow: The document is deleted for good. Hash and history remain. This cannot be undone.
delete_confirm_follow: The document is deleted for good and cannot be restored. Hash and history remain.
delete_confirm_check: I have checked that no retention period is running and confirm the final deletion.
delete_alone: To do that, invite e.g. your tax advisor on the page
rules_intro: Rules suggest a kind, tags, a document type or field values when classifying. All conditions of a rule must match; the first matching rule wins.
mailboxes_intro: Belegt fetches new mails via IMAP or JMAP every few minutes in the background. In the mailbox it only changes what you set as the action after fetching. The password is stored encrypted in the database.
export_title: Data medium for the tax audit (Z3)
export_intro: A ZIP with the originals of the period, tables of documents, mails and log, index.xml following the description standard, check value and checksums.
export_invalid: The start must be before the end.
invite_period: The period {von} to {bis} is released; Belegt only shows documents from that time.
procedure_legal_form: Legal form: for example sole proprietorship, GmbH or UG
procedure_responsible: Responsible: who is responsible for the archive and retention, who deputises and who helps
procedure_storage_location: Place of retention: where server, data and backups are located (country, data centre or office), for paper also where it is filed
procedure_supervision: Credit or securities institution or under insurance supervision (accounting vouchers 10 instead of 8 years)
procedure_backup: Backup: how, where, how often, who tests the restore
procedure_scan: Paper records and scanning: who scans, who checks, what happens to the paper (or: nothing is scanned)
procedure_server: Server operation: who runs it (yourself, a service provider, a hoster), who installs updates and how changes are approved
procedure_keys: Keys and passwords: where they are kept and who can reach them in an emergency; only the place, never the secrets themselves
tokens_intro: For programs that read or add documents (header Authorization: Bearer …). A token cannot delete or manage anything.
tokens_once: New token. Copy it into the program:
webhooks_intro: Belegt notifies an address by POST when a document is added, classified or deleted; only with the document ID, signed with the secret (X-Belegt-Signatur).
einvoice_hint: Read from the invoice XML; the original remains authoritative.
tokens_mcp: AI assistants connect via MCP (Streamable HTTP) with the same header at
report_hint: The check value is the head of the hash chain. Whoever notes it can later show that nothing was changed up to that entry.
oauth_connected: Mailbox connected. The first fetch follows with the next run or with “Fetch now”.
oauth_failed: The mailbox was not connected. Please try again.
oidc_not_linked: This account is not connected to Belegt yet. Sign in once with email and password, then connect it at the bottom left.
oidc_failed: Signing in through the provider did not work.
report_timestamp_none: none (TSA_URL not set or no run yet)
doc_derived_view: PDF view generated from the original. The original, available for download, is authoritative.
doc_searchable_view: Searchable PDF generated from the original. The original is authoritative.
open_with_error: Could not create the link for the other app. Please try again.
list_failed: The list could not be loaded: {meldung}
order_page_intro: Correspondents, tags, document types and custom fields organize the archive. They are metadata: changeable, and every change is in the history. The retention period still follows the kind.
order_tags_intro: Any number per document. Deleting a tag only removes its assignments, never a document.

match.anzahlPlural=one: Excluded for {anzahl} staff member or invitation: without the tag they will see its documents.
match.anzahlPlural=other: Excluded for {anzahl} staff members or invitations: without the tag they will see its documents.

order_doctypes_intro: At most one per document, such as contract or bank statement. The default kind suggests a kind when classifying; the retention period still follows the kind of the classification.
order_fields_intro: Values per document, such as contract number or total. The type is fixed once created; amounts in euros, entered in German notation like 1.234,56.
order_field_invalid: Not a valid value for this field.
order_field_invalid_amount: Not an amount. Please enter something like 1.234,56.
bulk_created_received: Created on the day of receipt
bulk_classify_hint: Without the checkbox Belegt only classifies documents in the inbox and skips the others. A new classification is added as a version; deleted documents cannot be classified.
bulk_rolled_back: Nothing changed: at least one document could not be changed.
offline_text: Belegt needs a connection to your server. The documents are stored there, not on this device.
share_intro: You shared these files with Belegt. They stay in this browser until you add them to the inbox.
share_owner_only: Only accounts that may add documents can add files.
share_empty_text: Share a file with Belegt on your phone and it appears here. This works with the installed app in Chrome or Edge on Android.
share_link_intro: Anyone with the link can download the original without signing in, nothing else. Every download is recorded.
pages_hint: The original stays unchanged. Rotating, removing and splitting create a new document that goes to the inbox.
pages_created: New document created, the original stays:
derived_order_hint: A derived document does not take over the tags, document type and fields of its source by itself.
derived_order_done: Tags, document type and fields applied.
derived_order_none: The source has no tags, no document type and no fields.
merge_hint: A new PDF with all pages in this order; the originals stay unchanged.
merge_done: Merged into the new document “{name}” in the inbox.
notes_hint: A note cannot be changed, only withdrawn. Auditors do not see notes.
paperless_intro: Belegt takes over documents from Paperless-ngx with tags, document types, custom fields and notes, through the API or from an export. Every original is checked against its checksum; the token is stored encrypted in the database.
paperless_export_hint: A ZIP from document_exporter with --zip. The import then runs in the background.
paperless_duplicates: {doppelt} of them already in the archive and only linked
paperless_mapping_intro: Paperless-ngx knows no retention period. Without a mapping every document lands in the inbox, with title, correspondent and date as a suggestion. If a document type or tag matches, Belegt classifies the document right away.
paperless_mapping_none: No mapping: everything lands in the inbox.
start_intro: What needs attention at a glance: inbox, retention, sources and the state of the chain.
start_inbox: In the inbox, not yet classified
start_retention_title: Retention ending in the next 90 days
start_sources_none: No mailboxes, no inbox folder and no migration yet.
start_views_none: Save a view in the archive, then you can show it here as a tile.
workflows_intro: When a document arrives or is classified and the conditions match, a workflow acts: tags, document type, field values, note, webhook. Rules under Sources only suggest.
workflow_conditions_hint: All filled-in conditions must match. Without conditions the workflow applies to every document of its trigger.
workflow_mime: File type, such as application/pdf or image/*
workflow_field_invalid: The value does not fit the field.
workflow_classify_hint: Sets the kind and with it the retention and locks the document, without anyone confirming. Only for documents in the inbox; the log shows workflow:<name>.
workflow_classify_date_erechnung: Date of the e-invoice, otherwise received
workflow_stop: If it matches, the following workflows do not run for this document
workflow_runs_none: No workflow has done anything yet.
match_hint: Checks file name, mail header and extracted text when a document arrives. The result is a suggestion in the inbox.
match_auto_hint: Belegt learns from your classifications and suggests when it is confident.
match_none_hint: No suggestion, not even a learned one.
order_parties_intro: Who a document comes from or goes to. Renaming and merging change only the list; the classification keeps the name it had when it was made.
order_parties_none: No correspondents yet. Every new name entered when classifying is added to the list.
party_merge_hint: Documents, rules and workflows get the chosen correspondent; this entry disappears from the list.
scope_any_hint: One of them is enough; none selected means no restriction.
scope_excluded_hint: The employee never sees documents with one of these tags.
scope_unsorted: Also documents without tag, type and correspondent (such as the inbox)
scope_text_unsorted: plus documents without tag, type and correspondent
invite_right_read: You see only part of the documents and can read them.
invite_right_edit: You see only part of the documents and can read, add and classify them.
mailbox_action_move_trash: move to the trash “{ordner}”, like deleting at the earliest {stunden} h after archiving
mailbox_action_move_trash_lock: move to the trash “{ordner}”, like deleting at the earliest {stunden} h after archiving and only once locked in the bucket
mailbox_move_trash_hint: This folder is a trash that empties itself. Belegt treats moving there like deleting: with confirmation, waiting time and comparison with the original.
mailbox_action_delete_after: delete, at the earliest {stunden} h after archiving
mailbox_action_delete_after_lock: delete, at the earliest {stunden} h after archiving and only once locked in the bucket
mailbox_delete_hint: Belegt deletes a mail in the mailbox only once it is completely in the archive and identical to the original byte for byte, and only after the waiting time, so that a backup of the archive can happen in between. Deleted is deleted: the mail cannot be restored in the mailbox afterwards.
mailbox_delete_all: On the first fetch, and when the server renumbers the folder (UIDVALIDITY) or, with JMAP, can no longer report its changes, Belegt fetches all mails of the folder again; after the waiting time it then deletes every one that is in the archive, including those archived long before.
mailbox_delete_after_lock: Only delete once the file is locked in the bucket until the end of its retention
mailbox_delete_confirm: I confirm that Belegt permanently deletes archived mails in this mailbox.
db_intro: The privileges Belegt uses to log in to the database. With separate roles the app can neither disable triggers nor alter or empty tables; the database checks what it may write.
db_restricted: Separate roles in effect: the login {anmeldung} has no owner or administrative privileges.
db_unrestricted: Warning: the login {anmeldung} has more privileges than needed.
db_problem_rollenwechsel: The session uses a role switch instead of its own login.
db_problem_replika: The replication mode is replica: lock, seal and audit triggers do not run.
db_problem_admin: The login has administrative privileges (such as superuser).
db_problem_eigentuemer: The login owns the database or its tables and could disable triggers.
db_problem_anlegen: The login can create objects in the database.
db_problem_temporaer: The login can create temporary tables.
db_problem_replikation: The login can change the replication mode and thereby disable triggers.
db_problem_dateien: The login can access files or programs of the database server.
db_problem_leeren: The login can empty tables or create triggers.
db_problem_schreiben: The login can write to tables it should only read or append to.
db_problem_vorgaben: The login has its own defaults (ALTER ROLE … SET); the next start with MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL resets them.
start_db_warning: Database: login with more privileges than needed
backup_intro: The backup container saves the database and originals daily with restic and regularly restores a backup into a throwaway database: chain, seals and every original are checked.
backup_none: No backup recorded yet. Without the backup container (or with a different backup) this stays empty.
backup_overdue: The last successful backup is from {zeit}; none has succeeded since. Is the backup container running?
account_intro: A second factor protects your sign-in, even if someone knows your password.
account_required: A second factor is required for your access. Set up TOTP or a passkey to continue.
account_totp_intro: After your password, Belegt asks for a six-digit code from an app such as Aegis, FreeOTP or your password manager.
account_totp_no_password: You sign in with your company account provider; the second factor is set up there.
account_totp_scan: Scan the code with your app and enter the code it shows.
account_totp_qr: QR code for the authenticator app
account_totp_secret: Or enter the key by hand:
account_totp_active: TOTP is set up. After your password, Belegt asks for the code.
account_backup_hint: Each code works once when you don't have the app at hand. Keep them safe; Belegt does not show them again.
account_backup_file_title: Backup codes for Belegt, each works once
account_passkeys_intro: With a passkey you sign in without a password, using a fingerprint, your face or a security key. Accounts with passkeys only sign in with them.
login_second_intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login_second_backup_intro: Enter one of your backup codes. It no longer works afterwards.
login_use_totp: Use the code from the app instead
access_2fa_policy_intro: For which roles a second factor is required. Accounts without one set it up at their next sign-in. Accounts signing in through the OIDC provider don't need one of their own.
start_mail_off: Email notifications are not set up.
notify_intro: Belegt emails you when something needs your attention: with numbers and a link, never with document contents.
notify_off: Sending is not set up: without MAIL_SMTP_URL in the environment of server and worker, Belegt sends no email.
notify_backup: Backup or test restore failed, or no backup for this many days
notify_mailbox: Mailbox not fetched for this many days, or an action in the mailbox failed
notify_chain: The daily check of the chain reports findings
notify_deletion: A deletion request waits for the second person
notify_retention: Weekly: retention periods ending in the next 30 days
notify_inbox: More documents in the inbox than
notify_more_hint: One address per line, at most 20.
notify_deletion_hint: Deletion requests go to the people who may confirm them, not to the additional addresses.
workflow_send_hint: Sends the original in the background as multipart/form-data to another app, such as an accounting tool; Belegt retries after an outage, and each document arrives at most once.
workflow_send_fields: Fixed fields, one name=value per line
workflow_send_fields_invalid: Each line of the fixed fields needs the form name=value.
zip_too_large: {groesse} in total: too large for one ZIP (at most 2 GB). Please select fewer.
start_chain_never: not checked yet; the worker checks once a day
start_chain_stale: No check for two days: is the worker running?
explain_asn: The archive number is a running number every document gets when it arrives. It never changes.
explain_seal: The seal is a fingerprint of the details of the document. If anything changes, it no longer matches.
explain_chain: Every entry in the log contains the fingerprint of the entry before it. Changing one breaks the chain, and the check shows it.
explain_hold: A hold keeps the documents of a period, even after their retention period has ended, for example for a tax audit.
explain_kind: The kind says how long a document must stay: required (legal period), voluntary (until a day you choose) or free (no period; can be deleted as long as no hold covers the day it was created).
server_down_title: The server is not responding right now.
denied_title: This access cannot show anything right now.
einmalwert_copy_failed: Copying is not possible, please select the value.
workflow_actions_empty: No action yet. Choose below what should happen to the document.
drop_text: They go to the inbox; the original stays unchanged.

match.anzahlPlural=one: {anzahl} file was already in the archive and was not added twice.
match.anzahlPlural=other: {anzahl} files were already in the archive and were not added twice.

global_search_all: All results for “{suche}” in the archive
